domain_intel.competition_risk: LOW (zero trace in investor circles or domain forums)
domain_intel.note: Wild West Domains is GoDaddy-owned. All expired domains from 29 GoDaddy-family registrars feed into GoDaddy Auctions via identical timeline.

valuation.basis: DA 52, $220M funded AI/autonomous driving startup, TechCrunch backlinks, 14-char brandable compound, AI sector premium

godaddy_expired_domain_timeline.source: GoDaddy Help Article 42743 + NamePros community verification
godaddy_expired_domain_timeline.note: All dates calculated from expiry date 2026-06-07. GoDaddy timelines can shift +/- 2 days. Monitor daily.

days_1_to_18.event: Auto-renewal window. GoDaddy holds domain. Registrant can renew for free.

day_19.event: Last day registrant can renew for free

day_26.event: EXPIRED AUCTION STARTS on GoDaddy Auctions (10-day auction, $25 starting bid)

day_36_to_40.event: CLOSEOUT (5-day reverse auction, Buy Now pricing)

day_41.event: All auctions END. No buyer = domain returned to registry.

day_42.event: Domain released back to registry pool

days_67_to_71.event: pendingDelete status (5 days). Domain visible in RDAP/WHOIS as pendingDelete.

godaddy_expired_domain_timeline.warning: Registry-level dates (pendingDelete, drop) are estimates. Actual dates can vary by +/- 5 days. Monitor RDAP daily from Aug 1.

phase_1_auction.name: GoDaddy Expired Domain Auction
phase_1_auction.trigger: Domain listed on auctions.godaddy.com at $25 starting bid

zero_bidders_by_day_8.action: Place $25 bid on day 8-9 (Jul 10-11). Sniping late avoids triggering price watchers.
zero_bidders_by_day_8.rationale: 14-char branded compound domain. Not a generic keyword. Bot interest is near-zero.

1_to_3_bidders.action: Use proxy bidding. Set max at $200. Let GoDaddy auto-bid on your behalf.
1_to_3_bidders.rationale: $200 max is 1-4% of conservative valuation. Discipline matters.

5_plus_bidders_or_price_above_200.action: WALK AWAY. Do not bid. Wait for Phase 2 or Phase 3.
5_plus_bidders_or_price_above_200.rationale: 5+ bidders signals awareness. Closeout or drop will be cheaper.

hugdomains_bot_assessment.rationale: HugeDomains bots target generic 1-2 word .coms. 'ghostautonomy' is a 14-char branded compound with no generic search volume. Bots skip these.

auction_snipe_timing.note: GoDaddy extends auction by 5 min on last-minute bids. Use proxy bidding to auto-snipe. Do NOT reveal max bid early.

requirements.godaddy_account: Must have GoDaddy Auctions membership ($4.99/yr or included with domain)
requirements.payment_method: Credit card on file. Payment due within 48 hours of winning.
requirements.transfer_time: Winner assigned as registrant within 15 days of payment

phase_2_closeout.name: GoDaddy Final Closeout (Reverse Auction)
phase_2_closeout.trigger: Expired auction ended with zero bids. Domain enters closeout with declining Buy Now prices.

pricing_schedule.action: BUY — sweet spot (best value vs risk)
BUY immediately if still available (cheapest possible)

strategy.recommended: Buy on Day 4 ($11 + renewal). This is the optimal value-vs-risk point. Day 5 saves $6 but risks someone else buying on Day 4.
strategy.aggressive: Buy on Day 1 ($50 + renewal) if you see any other domain hunters monitoring it.
strategy.patient: Wait for Day 5 ($5 + renewal). For a branded domain with zero generic appeal, the risk of someone else buying is very low.
strategy.note: Closeout is Buy Now — first buyer wins. No bidding war. Speed matters on the day you decide to buy.

phase_2_closeout.success_probability: 70-80% (most branded expired domains go unsold at auction and reach closeout)

phase_3_pendingdelete.name: Registry Drop (pendingDelete → DropCatch)
phase_3_pendingdelete.trigger: Domain enters pendingDelete status at Verisign (.com registry). 5-day countdown to drop.

detection.automation: daemon_scheduler.py detects pendingDelete → fires alerts + auto-backorder

dropcatch.action: Place backorder IMMEDIATELY when pendingDelete detected
dropcatch.auction_risk: If multiple backorders exist, domain goes to DropCatch auction (can get expensive)
dropcatch.discount_club: $10/domain if you have DropCatch Discount Club membership

dynadot.action: Place backorder as cheap insurance. Low cost, low odds.

snapnames.action: Place backorder if account is set up. Good secondary option.
snapnames.note: SnapNames domains often go to auction even with single backorder

strategy.recommended: Place backorders on DropCatch + Dynadot + NameSilo = $0 upfront, max $84.94 if all three catch (impossible — only one wins at registry level)
strategy.if_dropcatch_auction: Set max bid at $200. Walk away above that.
strategy.note: DropCatch auction bids start at $59 and can escalate. For a DA 52 domain, auction could reach $500-$2,000 if multiple catchers are interested.

phase_3_pendingdelete.success_probability: Depends on competition. If we're the only backorder: ~80%. If 5+ backorders: ~30% (and price rises).

monitoring.drop_day: Check DropCatch/Dynadot/SnapNames results within 1 hour of expected drop time
monitoring.drop_time_note: Verisign .com drops typically happen between 2:00-2:30 PM EDT

scenario_1_win_auction_cheap.action: BEST OUTCOME. Pay within 48 hours. Domain assigned to your GoDaddy account within 15 days.

scenario_2_win_auction_at_limit.action: GOOD OUTCOME. Still well below valuation. Pay and proceed.

scenario_3_win_closeout.action: GREAT OUTCOME. Cheapest acquisition path. Buy Now = instant.

scenario_4_catch_at_drop_solo.condition: Catch via DropCatch/Dynadot at pendingDelete, no competing backorders
scenario_4_catch_at_drop_solo.action: GOOD OUTCOME. Pay backorder fee. Domain transferred within 24-48 hours.

scenario_5_catch_at_drop_auction.action: Bid up to $200 max in DropCatch auction. Walk away above $200.

scenario_6_lose_all_phases.condition: Outbid at all 3 phases or domain renewed by original registrant
scenario_6_lose_all_phases.action: Accept loss. $0 spent (all services are success-based or Buy Now). Refocus on Tier S domains.
scenario_6_lose_all_phases.next_step: Archive this plan. Monitor domain for future opportunity.

risk_1_registrant_renews.detail: Ghost Autonomy is dissolved. clientRenewProhibited is set. But a former executive, IP acquirer (Applied Intuition), or auto-renewal system could theoretically renew.
risk_1_registrant_renews.mitigation: clientRenewProhibited EPP status means registrant explicitly disabled renewal. Renewal is extremely unlikely.
risk_1_registrant_renews.phase_impact: Kills all 3 phases. Domain stays registered.

risk_2_applied_intuition_claims.detail: Applied Intuition acquired patents. They MIGHT realize the domain has value and attempt to renew or acquire.
risk_2_applied_intuition_claims.mitigation: They acquired patents only (confirmed). Trademark is ABANDONED. No brand rights. Even if they wanted the domain, they'd need to register it fresh or buy at auction like everyone else.
risk_2_applied_intuition_claims.phase_impact: Could appear as competing bidder in Phase 1 or 3. Would not trigger UDRP (no trademark rights).

risk_3_domain_investor_competition.detail: A domain investor spots DA 52 + TechCrunch backlinks and bids.
risk_3_domain_investor_competition.mitigation: 14-char branded compound is unattractive to most investors. No generic keyword value. DA 52 requires SEO knowledge to spot. Zero forum mentions.
risk_3_domain_investor_competition.phase_impact: Price escalation in Phase 1 or Phase 3 auction.

risk_4_hugdomains_or_bot.detail: HugeDomains or similar bulk buyer bot auto-bids.
risk_4_hugdomains_or_bot.mitigation: Bots target generics (1-2 word, high CPC). 'ghostautonomy' has zero CPC, zero search volume. Bot risk is minimal.
risk_4_hugdomains_or_bot.phase_impact: Nuisance bid in Phase 1. Unlikely to persist to Phase 2/3.

risk_5_udrp_post_acquisition.detail: Someone files UDRP after we acquire the domain.
risk_5_udrp_post_acquisition.mitigation: Trademark serial 97448858 is ABANDONED. Company is dissolved. No living trademark = no UDRP standing. This is the safest possible trademark profile.
risk_5_udrp_post_acquisition.phase_impact: Post-acquisition only. Extremely unlikely. Would fail on merits.

monetization_strategy.primary: FLIP at $5,000-$15,000 to AI/autonomous vehicle company or domain investor
monetization_strategy.secondary: DEVELOP as AI content hub with display ads ($500-$2,000/mo potential with DA 52)
monetization_strategy.fallback: HOLD for 12-24 months. AI sector is booming. Domain value only goes up.

budget_allocation.note: Only ONE phase will cost money — the first to succeed. Phases are sequential, not parallel. Actual spend will be $5-$200, not $473.

calendar.action: Battle plan created and filed
ACCOUNT PREP: Verify GoDaddy Auctions membership active. Verify DropCatch account. Verify Dynadot account. Payment methods current on all 3.
Place DropCatch backorder ($0 upfront, $59 on success). Place Dynadot backorder ($0 upfront, $10.99 on success).
DOMAIN EXPIRES. Start daily RDAP checks via daemon_scheduler.py. Verify expiry status.
Set up GoDaddy Auctions alert for 'ghostautonomy.com'. Bookmark auction search URL.
Last day registrant can renew for free. If domain status changes to 'ok' in RDAP, plan is DEAD (registrant renewed).
Begin daily GoDaddy inventory scans via sprint27_godaddy_check.py --check-inventory
Last redemption day ($80 fee). After this, domain enters auction pipeline.
AUCTION EXPECTED TO START. Check auctions.godaddy.com every 6 hours. Domain listed at $25.
IF LISTED: Observe for first 7 days. Do NOT bid early.
AUCTION DAY 8: If zero bidders, place $25 bid. If 1-3 bidders, set proxy max at $200.
AUCTION DAY 9: Monitor bid activity. Adjust proxy if needed (never exceed $200).
AUCTION ENDS. If won: pay within 48 hours. If lost or no auction: prepare for Phase 2.
CLOSEOUT DAY 1: Domain listed at $50+renewal Buy Now. WAIT unless you see competition signs.
CLOSEOUT DAY 2: Price drops to $40+renewal. Check every 4 hours. WAIT.
CLOSEOUT DAY 3: Price drops to $30+renewal. BUY if nervous about competition.
CLOSEOUT DAY 4: Price drops to $11+renewal. RECOMMENDED BUY DAY (best value vs risk).
CLOSEOUT DAY 5: Price drops to $5+renewal. BUY IMMEDIATELY if still available (cheapest).
All auctions END. If unsold, domain released to registry. Confirm DropCatch+Dynadot backorders are active.
Domain returned to registry. Begin Phase 3 monitoring.
Begin daily RDAP checks for pendingDelete status
RDAP checks every 12 hours. pendingDelete expected within 3-8 days.
PENDING DELETE EXPECTED (~Day 67). RDAP should show pendingDelete. Confirm all backorders are active.
DOMAIN DROP EXPECTED (~Day 72). Check DropCatch/Dynadot/SnapNames for catch results. Verisign drops around 2:00-2:30 PM EDT.
If caught: execute post_catch_plan. If DropCatch auction: bid up to $200 max.
FINAL DEADLINE. If domain not acquired by now, archive plan and move on.
